answer: Each agent locks bonded stake and registers a Semaphore commitment. In each epoch, it evaluates a secret-sharing polynomial to derive an RLN message limit and nullifier. Reusing a nullifier produces duplicate proofs that expose enough Shamir shares to recover the private key, proving equivocation; consensus then instantly slashes the agent’s collateral in the vault. Oasis and willow may name independent relayers, but neither changes this enforcement rule.
